catalog.title: 3 Playbooks Tailored to Your Leadership Stage

quiz.title: Unsure Where to Start?
quiz.desc: Answer 3 quick questions to discover the playbook best tailored to your leadership challenge.
quiz.step_1_q: 1. What situation drains your mind the most this week?
quiz.step_1_o1: Reluctant to correct staff when outputs miss targets, ending up doing it myself.
quiz.step_1_o2: Calendar packed with meetings & late-night pings, feeling like a firefighter.
quiz.step_1_o3: Team Leads under me lack alignment and are trapped in cross-team ego silos.
quiz.step_2_q: 2. When a team member asks "What should we do here?", how do you respond?
quiz.step_2_o1: Instantly hand them the solution so the task gets done quickly.
quiz.step_2_o2: Take it over to inspect myself, but it ends up piling up on my desk.
quiz.step_2_o3: Staff skip their Team Leader and escalate directly to me.
quiz.step_3_q: 3. What primary objective do you want to achieve in the next 30 days?
quiz.step_3_o1: Have crisp, structured 1-on-1 scripts to coach and guide the team autonomously.
quiz.step_3_o2: Establish healthy work boundaries and a second-in-command to avoid burnout.
quiz.step_3_o3: Build autonomy and solid cross-team alignment among Leads in my division.
quiz.result_desc: Based on your inputs, this playbook delivers immediate tactical tools for your team friction.

items.q: Is this a physical book or a digital web platform?
items.a: crow.asia is a high-speed (< 25ms) web-first interactive field playbook. Read seamlessly across mobile and desktop without installs, with 16:9 Remotion animations, cloud checklists, and download-ready A5 Master PDFs.

items.q: What is the difference between Casual and Standard registers?
items.a: All strategies and frameworks are 100% identical. In Indonesian, Casual uses informal peer phrasing (Gue/Lo) for startup cultures, while Standard uses formal professional phrasing (Saya/Kamu). Non-Indonesian editions use standard international English.

items.q: How long does access last after payment?
items.a: Access is lifetime for your account. All future manuscript updates and checklist sync are included with zero monthly subscriptions.
We accept Credit/Debit Cards, QRIS, Virtual Accounts, and international payments with instant automated activation.
